name: Stalk
source:
You never asked to be part of someone else's game. But when the developers of Mr. Killer —the hit dating sim that turns real tragedies into romance— used your family's story for content, your pain became their profit.

Now a killer wearing the Ghostface mask from the game's most popular chapter is hunting you and your friends. Your world becomes a real-life horror story where the line between slasher and dating sim has blurred, and the killer's obsession is far more personal than you ever imagined.

With a gun in your hand and the killer closing in, your choices determine your ending. Will you be the Final Girl, or will you choose the monster?

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/stalk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从来没有要求参与别人的游戏。但是，当《杀手先生》——一款将真实悲剧变成浪漫的热门约会模拟游戏——的开发商用你家人的故事作为内容时，你的痛苦就变成了他们的利润。

现在，一个戴着游戏最受欢迎章节中的鬼面面具的杀手正在追捕你和你的朋友。你的世界变成了现实生活中的恐怖故事，杀人狂和约会模拟之间的界限已经模糊，而杀手的痴迷比你想象的更加个人化。

手里拿着枪，杀手逼近，你的选择决定了你的结局。你会成为最后的女孩，还是会选择怪物？

[来自[url=https://khywae.itch.io/stalk]Itch.io[/url]]
